description: Add rows to ONE specific enrichment sheet owned by the authenticated user, by its exact sheetId. People and company search results can be passed exactly as returned; nested objects become flat columns. Keys may be stable column ids, semantic keys such as fullName/companyDomain, exact renamed column labels, or new field names. New fields become referenceable columns; matching people/companies keep their existing values while empty cells are completed from the new payload. Unchanged duplicates are skipped. The result includes the exact ids and labeled values of every newly added row so they can be used immediately.

rows.description: One to 25 people/company records to append, flat or as the people and company searches returned them.
